en: Black‑and‑white rural scene showing a dirt path leading through open fields toward a small village of farmhouses and barns. The buildings are mostly timber or stone with steep, tiled roofs, some half‑timbered. Leafless trees and fenced yards surround the houses, and rolling hills form the distant background. No printed caption or visible handwriting appears on the image side.
